[`start_share`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/dialoghelper/capture.html#start_share)
asks the browser to share a screen or window, which the user picks.
[`capture_screen`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/dialoghelper/capture.html#capture_screen)
then grabs a frame of it. Both send `screenshot.js` with their
[`browser`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/dialoghelper/core.html#browser)
call, so no setup step is needed.

### capture_tool

``` python
async def capture_tool(
    timeout:int=15
):
```

*Capture the screen. Re-call this function to get the most recent
screenshot, as needed. Use default timeout where possible*

After the user picks a window to share,
[`capture_screen`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/dialoghelper/capture.html#capture_screen)
grabs a frame of it:

``` python
img = await capture_screen()
img.thumbnail((700,700))
img
```
